title: RNA-Mediated Gene Silencing: RNA Interference
method: Whitespace count of saved HTML p.teaching-prose only. Article count includes expanded answers, excludes SVG and buttons.
scope_review: Official merged NET printed p4, separate NET p3, archived MP SET p3 visually checked. Roadmap microtopics covered; advanced chromatin and piRNA details excluded.
scientific_review: Internal review of lin-4/lin-14 1993, Fire 1998, Dicer/siRNA 2001, Ago2 2004, strand selection, plant DCL1/HEN1, mirtrons and miR-451, seed and central pairing, RNA decay and 2010 Guo evidence. Checked substrate, orientation, cleavage products, comparisons and experimental inference.
teaching_review: Second review strengthened distractors, removed repeating key pattern, added section-specific evidence links and 2010 experimental explanation, corrected schematic stagger and central cut markers and styled question cards.

comparator.comparison: Comparable substantial theory length; 133 distinct paragraphs, not HTML size proxy.

academic_self_review.method: Internal author/editor assessment, not external certification. Deductions for accessible source limits, simplified schematics and model assumptions, remaining distractor breadth, and no independent rendered-browser/mobile audit.

limitations: Internal review, not external peer review.
Archived MP SET 2024 syllabus, not independently verified current MPPSC original.
Selected accessible sources and abstracts, not all full papers.
Static checks; interactive mobile/browser and comprehensive accessibility tests not performed.
